title: Chariots of fire as angelic vehicles

tellings.quote: However, in the narrative, you have these other vehicles that are called the chariots of God or the chariots of Israel or the chariots of fire.

plain: The 'chariots of fire' in the Bible were vehicles flown by angelic beings, says Tim Alberino, a guest who tells Michels of capturing a giant in Afghanistan. He points to the King James Bible of 1611, where the narrative speaks of 'the chariots of God', 'the chariots of Israel' and 'chariots of fire' alongside its ordinary chariots. The text sets these apart as something that comes from God; whether that means craft in a modern sense, it does not say either way, which leaves Alberino's reading as one way to take the story.
